figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: Figure 1 Map of Antarctica with indication of the deep drilling sites. The Dome Fuji site is located about 1,000 km from the coast at the highest point of the East Dronning Maud Land Plateau: 3,810 m above sea level (a.s.l.), accumulation ,2.7 g cm22 yr21, 10-m depth temperature of 258 8C (ref. 9). The core covers 2,503 m, whereas the ice thickness is 3,090 m.

figures.title: Figure 2
figures.llm_description: Figure 2 Evolution of the energy as a function of the soft-mode distortion y. First-principles results (symbols) and electrostatic model results (lines) are shown for different thicknesses of the ferroelectric thin film: m ¼ 2 (circles, full line), m ¼ 4 (upward-pointing triangles, dotted), m ¼ 6 (diamonds, short-dashed), m ¼ 8 (squares, dot-dashed), and m ¼ 10 (downward-pointing triangles, long-dashed). The magnitude of y is reported as a percentage of the bulk soft-mode displacements of BaTiO3

figures.title: Figure 3
figures.llm_description: Figure 3 Induced dipoles, potentials and depolarizing fields along the [001] direction of the short-circuited ferroelectric capacitor.
